text: Captures full stack trace, environment, browser, version, class name, and host details for each error
quote: see the full stack trace, environment, browser, version, class name, host, and more

text: Connects to GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab repos to show source context and suspect code
quote: Connect to your repo through native integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab, with support for source map decoding.

text: Prioritizes and orders errors by number of users affected and occurrence count
quote: Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences, and use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.

text: Smart filters let you segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags
quote: Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences, and use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.

text: AI-powered suggestions identify the root cause of errors and propose fixes
quote: Resolve issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy using AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them.

text: Built-in collaborative AI chat tool with live typing indicators for teammates
quote: You can chat with this tool collaboratively. Typing indicators are shown whenever teammates are typing, so it's always clear who is using the chat.

text: Can post a link from the AI chat conversation directly into an issue's comments
quote: Simply press the comment button in the AI chat, and it will create a link back to your conversation to be posted into the comments section.

text: Groups duplicate errors into one issue based on exception type, class name, method name, and stack trace location
quote: Raygun groups errors based on the `exception type`, `class name`, `method name`, and the location within the `stack trace`.

text: Provides external access tokens scoped to specific APIs (deployments, dSYM upload, ProGuard mapping, JS upload)
quote: You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files, Uploading JavaScript files directly to Raygun

text: Can export all or selected error groups from the Crash Reporting dashboard
quote: The Raygun Crash Reporting export feature allows customers to export all error groups or selected errors groups from within the Crash Reporting dashboard.

text: Errors can be manually marked as Resolved once fixed
quote: Once you've fixed a particular error, you can mark an it as 'Resolved'.

text: Supports ignore rules based on time period, occurrence count, or custom rule conditions
quote: We provide three types of conditions: Ignore for a specific time period ... Ignore for a specific number of occurrences ... Ignore by rule

text: Can filter out sensitive data like credit card numbers from error payloads before they reach Raygun
quote: You can filter out sensitive information from error data, meaning before errors are sent to Raygun. This enables you to remove sensitive data such as credit card details when sending errors from your application.

text: Can disable storage of user IP addresses via an application setting
quote: To stop the storage of IP addresses you can go to your "Application settings" page in Raygun and then enabling the "Disable IP address storage" flag.

text: Automatically fetches publicly available JavaScript source maps to unminify stack traces
quote: If your source maps are publicly available on your website Raygun will fetch them automatically without you having to do anything.

text: Supports manual upload of source maps via the website's JS source map center or via API
quote: If the automatic option does not work for your application you can also manually upload source maps either through our website using the `JS source map center` or via our API

text: Can route APM trace alerts to a chosen Slack channel and trigger PagerDuty incidents from alert rules
quote: Now when an issue is triggered from this rule, a PagerDuty incident will be created and your incident team will be notified by PagerDuty.

text: CSV exports can be aligned to match applied dashboard filters (pages, tags, country codes, etc.)
quote: Aligned **CSV exports** with applied top-level filters. Exported data now matches filtered views for: Most Requested Pages, Tags, Country codes, Other top-level filters

text: Adds an error chart visualization to the search results page showing frequency and trends
quote: Added **error chart** visualization to **search results page**. Provides visual insight into error frequency and trends.

text: Provides a visual timeline of server-side timing information to speed up problem identification
quote: Developers can identify problems more quickly, enjoying a visual timeline of server-side timing information.

text: Lets you see what users saw in the browser to understand poor-quality user experiences
quote: You'll be able to see what your users see in the browser and discover why users had poor quality experiences.
